LAMP-LIT DUSK, FIRST LAMPS ON: deep blue dusk settling over the roofline with the wall's iron lamps just catching, each one dropping warm amber across the stone in flat stepped bands, the arch pooling in orange shadow while every lamp doubles and wobbles in the wet cobbles below

LAMP-LIT DUSK, FULL BLUE HOUR: the sky a rich saturated blue above the parapet and every iron lamp burning full gold now, washing the near stone face in honey-orange while the far courses step into deep blue, the cobbles carrying each lamp's warmth in broken flat pixel bands

LAMP-LIT DUSK, WINDOWS COMING ON: deep blue overhead and a hundred small warm-amber windows alight in the wall above the arch, their glow stepping down the stone in dithered bands of orange and ochre while the ground lies in cool blue shadow broken by each lamp's flat golden patch

LAMP-LIT DUSK, WET COBBLES BLAZING: a rich indigo dusk with every lamp and lit window doubled and scattered in the rain-wet cobbles, the stone face striped in warm gold and cool blue in flat pixel steps, the arch interior glowing a deep burnt orange against the darkening sky

LAMP-LIT DUSK, ARCH IN SHADOW: the blue-hour sky deep and saturated above, the wall's lamps pouring amber across the upper courses in chunky flat bands while the arch falls into warm amber shadow, the cobbles carrying each lamp as a broken scatter of gold against blue-black wet stone

LOW GOLD, LEFT FLANK BLAZING: late-afternoon sun driving in hard from the left, the whole west face of the gatehouse flooded in hot honey across flat stepped stone courses, the right flank stepping abruptly into deep violet shadow, long shadows reaching right across the trodden ground in hard pixel edges

LOW GOLD, TILES BURNING: low sun raking across the roof line and turning each blocky stacked tile to hot copper and amber, the stone face below it washed honey-gold on one side and dropping to cool violet on the other, every ledge casting its own flat shadow band down the wall below

LOW GOLD, RAKING THE COURSES: the low sun coming in nearly flat so every course of stone casts its own small stepped shadow beneath it, the lit faces burning warm amber and the shadowed faces a rich cool violet, the ground striped in long flat bands of gold and deep blue-grey

LOW GOLD, GROUND SHADOWS LONG: hot amber late sun flooding one face of the arch in stepped honey-orange while the other drops to deep violet, the ground in front of the gate bright trodden gold cut through by long hard-edged shadows stepping across the cobbles in flat pixel bands

BRIGHT HIGH MORNING, HARD SHADOWS: strong clean morning sun overhead, the stone face blazing a warm bright ochre against a deep saturated blue sky, every ledge and bracket casting a hard-edged cool shadow straight down the wall in flat dithered steps, the arch interior a deep cool blue-grey

BRIGHT HIGH MORNING, ARCH DEEP: full morning light pouring across the upper wall in bright warm gold, the blocky roof tiles hot and saturated, and the arch cutting a deep sharp-edged cool blue shadow into the bright face, each course above it stepping into sunlight through three clean flat bands

BRIGHT HIGH MORNING, TILES HOT: high clear sun washing the stone a clean warm gold, the blocky stacked roof tiles blazing amber and rust at the top of the frame, hard cool shadows tucked tight beneath every ledge in flat stepped bands, the ground in front bright and pale-gold

BRIGHT HIGH MORNING, SATURATED STONE: sharp overhead sun, the stone courses bright and saturated amber-gold against a clean deep blue sky, every block casting its own small stepped shadow down the face, the arch interior a pool of rich cool blue-grey against the warm blaze of the wall around it

FIRST LIGHT, PINK OVER THE PARAPET: pale rose-gold light just cresting the roofline and washing the top courses of the wall in warm pink-gold while the ground stays pale and cool blue with frost, one brazier at the arch burning low and steady amber in the cold blue-grey below

FIRST LIGHT, FROST ON THE GROUND: early pink-gold light catching the upper wall in warm stepped bands of rose and ochre while the frost-pale ground holds its cool blue in flat dithered steps, the brazier at the arch gate throwing a small steady pool of warm amber across the blue cobbles

FIRST LIGHT, GOLD ABOVE BLUE BELOW: the sky warming fast to gold and apricot at the parapet top while the lower wall and ground remain a cool flat blue, the stone stepping through three dithered bands from warm pink at the top to cool shadow at the base, the brazier amber against it all

WARM RAIN, COBBLES DARK: soft bright light under a warm grey sky, every stone course deepened and saturated, the cobbles dark and wet-dark with each iron lamp already doubled and scattered in the wet surface, the arch wall's wet streaks under the ledges picking up the warm grey glow in flat bands

WARM RAIN, LAMPS IN PUDDLES: a warm overcast rain-light making the stone deep amber-ochre and every shadow a rich warm brown, the lamps already lit and their warmth doubling in broken flat pixel bands across the wet cobbles, the courses under the arch dark with wet streaks stepped in flat dithered tones

WARM RAIN, DEEP AND WET: rain light making every colour richer and denser, the stone face a deep saturated amber against the warm grey sky, the wet ledges under each course picking up a pale gleam in flat stepped bands, the arch pooling in warm ochre shadow with the lamps burning gold inside

SNOW-LIGHT, BLUE AND ORANGE: cold clear blue light over deep snow, the stone wall gone pale and cool with lilac shadows stepping in flat bands under every course, while a scatter of small hot-orange windows burns through the wall's slits and from above the parapet into the cold blue air

SNOW-LIGHT, LILAC SHADOWS: clear winter light washing the gatehouse face a flat cool white-blue, every shadow under every ledge stepping into lilac in flat dithered bands, the deep snow on the ground pale and flat, small orange windows burning warm and steady from above the arch against the cold blue stone

SNOW-LIGHT, WINDOWS WARM: pale blue-white snow-light lying flat across the stone and ground, the wall's courses stepping from white-blue to lilac in shadow, each orange-lit window a warm saturated patch against the cool, the arch's interior a deeper lilac-grey with the lamp inside burning amber against the cold blue field

NIGHT AND MOON, SILVER ON STONE: deep indigo night with a big soft moon low over the parapet, its silver-blue light lying across the stone in flat pale bands and the shadows stepping to deep blue-black under every ledge, the gate's iron lamps burning warm amber-gold against the cool indigo around them

NIGHT AND MOON, LAMP GOLD VS INDIGO: deep indigo sky with moonlight washing the upper wall silver-blue in flat dithered steps, each lamp burning a strong warm gold that warms the stone below it in stepped bands, the arch interior a deep blue-black with the lamps' warm glow stepping down the cobbles in flat pixel patches

NIGHT AND MOON, GOLD AND BLUE: the moon laying a cool blue-silver wash across the snow and the pale upper courses in flat bands, while the wall's iron lamps pour amber-gold down the lower stone in chunky stepped tones, the cobbles carrying the lamps as a broken scatter of warm gold in cool blue-grey
